title: ApiApplication
description: Configuration for an application that exposes a web API.

acceptMappedClaims.description: If true, allows an application to use claims mapping without specifying a custom signing key.

knownClientApplications.description: Used for bundling consent. Lists client app IDs that are considered known clients of this API.

oauth2PermissionScopes.description: The definition of the delegated permissions exposed by the web API.

preAuthorizedApplications.description: Lists applications that are pre-authorized with specified delegated permissions.

requestedAccessTokenVersion.description: The access token version expected by this resource. Possible values are 1 or 2.
